name: labs/pymodaq__pymodaq_plugins_oceaninsight
title: Ocean Insight spectrometer (PyMoDAQ Omnidriver plugin)
intro: Ocean Insight spectrometer (PyMoDAQ Omnidriver plugin), adapted from pymodaq/pymodaq_plugins_oceaninsight. It reads `wavelength_min_nm`, `wavelength_max_nm` and `pixel_count`; sets `integration_time_ms`; runs `measure_intensity`. `measure_intensity`: measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
